Getting Started with Empire Server

Published on June 10, 2026 | By Empire Team

Introduction

Empire is a lightweight HTTP server built with TypeScript. In this post, we'll explore the basics and show you how to get started.

Key Features

The server is designed to be simple yet powerful, with support for static file serving, multiple routes, and easy extensibility.

Getting Started

To get started with Empire, simply clone the repository and run npm install. Then use npm start to launch the server.
